John Coolidge Adams, born in 1947, is an acclaimed American composer, conductor, and writer whose music is rooted in minimalism, though he is widely regarded as a pioneer of post-minimalism. His compositions combine the motoric drive and repeating loops of minimalism with the dramatic sweep, rich orchestration, and emotional depth of late-Romanticism. Adams is particularly famous for his docu-operas, which dramatize controversial, real-life events of the late twentieth century.

Nixon in China from 1987 is his landmark first opera, with a libretto by Alice Goodman, depicting Richard Nixon's historic nineteen seventy-two diplomatic visit. It features the iconic minimalist-backed aria News has a kind of mystery and Chiang Ch'ing, or Madame Mao's, coloratura aria I am the wife of Mao Tse-tung. Harmonielehre from 1985 is a massive three-movement symphonic work named after Arnold Schoenberg's textbook on harmony. Its creation was inspired by a vivid dream Adams had of a giant tanker truck exploding out of San Francisco Bay and flying like a rocket. On the Transmigration of Souls from 2002 is a choral and orchestral piece commissioned to commemorate the victims of the September eleventh attacks. It blends live performers with tape loops of street noises and whispered names of the victims, and it won the Pulitzer Prize for Music. Doctor Atomic from 2005 is an opera centering on J. Robert Oppenheimer and the scientists of the Manhattan Project in the final hours before the Trinity test, with its emotional climax being Oppenheimer's aria setting John Donne's holy sonnet Batter my heart, three-person'd God. The Death of Klinghoffer from 1991 is a highly controversial opera dramatizing the nineteen eighty-five hijacking of the cruise ship Achille Lauro by the Palestine Liberation Front and the murder of wheelchair-bound passenger Leon Klinghoffer. Shaker Loops from 1978 is a kinetic early piece for string septet, later arranged for string orchestra, that utilizes rapidly oscillating bow strokes called shimmers and loops to mimic the spiritual shaking dances of the Shaker religious sect.

Adams is a leading contemporary voice in American music alongside Philip Glass and Steve Reich, having pioneered the news opera or docu-opera genre, transforming contemporary headlines into operatic drama.
